svg.text: Family net worth by reference-person education
Median net worth and college-to-high-school wealth ratio, 1989–2025
Median net worth · thousands of 2025 dollars
Median wealth ratio · college group ÷ high-school-or-less group
Source: Federal Reserve SCF public summary extracts. Bars show 95% intervals combining replicate-weight sampling and imputation variance.
Education is of the reference person; some college/associate degree group excluded. Weighted medians average five implicates; 2025 dollars.
